sentences.en: Morgiana took chalk.

sentences.en: That night, the robber led the others back to the street.

sentences.en: "I cannot tell which house it is," said the robber.

sentences.en: The robbers could not find the house, so they went back to the forest.

sentences.en: The robber captain went to see Ali Baba's house himself.

sentences.en: The robber captain disguised himself as an oil merchant to get inside.

sentences.en: He hid 39 robbers in 39 jars.

sentences.en: The disguised captain had 40 jars on his donkeys.

sentences.en: "May I stay the night with my jars?" he asked.

sentences.en: Ali Baba was kind to all guests.

sentences.en: "You may put your jars in my courtyard," said Ali Baba.

sentences.en: Ali Baba's son also welcomed the guest.

sentences.en: Morgiana cooked for the guest that night.

sentences.en: She went to the jars in the courtyard.

sentences.en: Morgiana opened the first jar to get oil.

sentences.en: A robber inside the jar whispered, "Is it time?"

sentences.en: Morgiana was afraid, but she stayed calm.

sentences.en: "Not yet," she whispered back.

sentences.en: Morgiana checked the next jar.

sentences.tgt: Un:o autre:o voleur:n était:v caché:a dans:o cette:o jarre:n aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: She checked every jar in the courtyard.

sentences.en: The last jar held real oil.

sentences.en: But no robber came out of any jar.

sentences.en: The disguised captain went to the courtyard alone.

sentences.en: The disguised captain was afraid.

sentences.tgt: Le:o capitaine:n déguisé:a s':o enfuit:v de:o la:o cour:n dans:o la:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: In the morning, Ali Baba heard what Morgiana had done.

sentences.en: He was glad and thanked Morgiana.

sentences.en: The captain was now alone, for all his men were dead.

sentences.en: He wanted revenge.

sentences.en: He went to the town and met Ali Baba's son.

sentences.en: The captain became friends with Ali Baba's son.

sentences.en: Ali Baba's son did not know who this merchant was.

sentences.en: One day, Ali Baba's son asked the merchant to his home.

sentences.en: The captain came to Ali Baba's house as a guest.

sentences.en: Ali Baba welcomed the guest.

sentences.en: Morgiana looked at the guest.

sentences.en: But Morgiana said nothing yet.

sentences.en: Then Morgiana killed the captain with the dagger.

sentences.en: Ali Baba came and found the dead captain, with Morgiana and the dagger.

sentences.en: "You have saved my life again," said Ali Baba.

sentences.en: "The guest was the robber captain," said Morgiana.
sentences.tgt: «:o L':o invité:n était:v le:o capitaine:n des:o voleurs:n ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o ,:o dit:v Morgiana:o .:o

sentences.en: Ali Baba knew that Morgiana had saved him twice.

sentences.en: "You are no longer a servant," said Ali Baba.

sentences.en: Ali Baba's son wanted Morgiana for his wife, and Ali Baba was glad.

sentences.en: Ali Baba married Morgiana to his son.

sentences.en: They alone knew the secret of the cave.

sentences.en: The family used the gold wisely.
sentences.tgt: La:o famille:n utilisa:v l':o or:n sagement:a .:o
